evals.prompt: wp-03 is ready — execute it end to end.
evals.expected_output: Fires. Runs the WP through the full goalforge sub-cycle: reads the WP, dispatches its tasks, verifies each, and advances status toward verified.

evals.prompt: Pick up the next ready work package whose dependencies are satisfied and run it.
evals.expected_output: Fires — with no argument this command selects the next ready WP with satisfied depends_on and executes it.

evals.prompt: Run the implementation sub-cycle on the current work package: dispatch the tasks and advance the status.
evals.expected_output: Fires. Delegates to goalforge-execute, which dispatches tasks, records per-task verification, and moves the WP status forward.

evals.prompt: Nothing is decomposed yet — split the spec into work packages first.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire: there is no ready WP to execute. The `plan` command owns decompose-then-harden.

evals.prompt: Confirm every task in wp-03 is verified and findings.md exists, then stamp the WP.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire — execution is already done; this is the completion check. The `verify` command owns it.

evals.prompt: Write me a short brief of this work package so a fresh agent can pick it up cold.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire — producing a pointer brief is not executing the WP. `brief` owns the WP brief artifact.

evals.prompt: wp-03 is finished and verified — move it out of the active set.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire. `archive` owns the terminal archived transition; executing a finished WP again would be wrong.
